entities.name: Vitalie Grușac
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vitaly Gruşac is a Moldovan Olympic medal boxer from Grimancauti village. He competed in the Welterweight division at the 2000 Summer Olympics. Gruşac qualified for the 2004 Summer Olympics by taking second place at the 4th AIBA European 2004 Olympic Qualifying Tournament in Baku, Azerbaijan.
